sources.entry: MySQL Workbench - The official MySQL GUI.

summary.name: MySQL Workbench
summary.one_liner: MySQL Workbench is the official integrated GUI tool from MySQL for database design, SQL development, administration and migration.
use_cases: installing a MySQL GUI on macOS or Windows
summary.what_it_does: MySQL Workbench provides DBAs and developers an integrated tools environment. It covers database design and modeling, SQL development, database administration, and database migration. The Community (OSS) Edition is available from the page under the GPL. The page lists LGPL library source packages used by the application, with separate lists for OS X and Windows, and notes that the latest version is backwards compatible with all currently supported MySQL Server versions.
notable: Official MySQL GUI covering design, development, administration and migration
Backwards compatible with all currently supported MySQL Server versions
caveats: The legacy MySQL GUI Tools Bundle (Administrator, Query Browser, Migration Toolkit) is end-of-life and only available as archives
Windows install requires listed prerequisite libraries
